turns.replyText:
Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
To get the best results, the biggest “pairing” is keeping your scalp clean so the laser light isn’t blocked by product buildup.
For shampoo/conditioner: we recommend gentle, sulfate-free shampoos and conditioners that cleanse without leaving residue.
If you use topical treatments like rosemary oil, you can use them alongside Theradome—just make sure your scalp is clean and free of products during the actual 20-minute Theradome session, then apply oils/treatments after the session.
If you want to add a supplement, we recommend Viviscal and/or Nutrafol.
